children: Clearway Energy entered into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire interests in a target company that will indirectly own three Utah battery energy storage projects totaling about 210 MW. The base purchase price is approximately $119 million in cash, subject to model-based adjustments. At closing, Clearway will own 100% of the Target Company’s class A units, while Clearway Renew, an affiliate of Clearway Energy Group, will own 100% of the class C units. Closing is expected in Q4 2027, subject to customary conditions and third-party actions.
